summary: A docs folder whose remote rewrote the same line
description: The one situation a pull cannot mend on its own. Both sides changed the same line of the same file, so `git pull` stops mid-merge and writes both versions into the working tree with its markers between them. Everything around that line is untouched on purpose — a conflict that swallowed the whole file would prove nothing about drawing a *region*, and the paragraphs before and after are what the preview has to keep showing while the markers are cut out of it.

write.docs/roadmap.md:
# Roadmap

## Phase 1 — MVP

The line both sides rewrote is the one below this paragraph, and it is the
only one they touched.

M2 closes with full-text search.

## Phase 2

Everything after here is untouched by either side, which is what makes the
conflict a region rather than the whole file.
